duration.text: The Medical Imageology at Chongqing Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.In principle, applicants should be over the age of 18 and under the age of 30. 2.Applicants must be healthy, both mentally and physically. 3.Applicant should have got the senior school leaving certificate upon registration with CQMU. 4.The applicants for Chinese-medium programs need to have passed the Chinese HSK test with Grade 3 of Elementary Level, or have a statement from their embassy which proves that their secondary education was conducted in Chinese
